limits: Six authenticated predecessor fields only. No old action is admitted as a base-v3 response; shafts 079 and 080 have moved.

Affine signed density is one continuous prescribed-action equilibrium trial over nominal full bearing intervals. Neither physical stiffness, contact distribution, bore-wall deformation nor compatibility among the three members is established.
Directional scalar lower bounds are necessary, not sufficient for the vector problem. Affine endpoint peaks are an equilibrated trial, not a minimum peak or an actual pressure prediction.

Fe90 is the existing NDS DF-L 5%-offset bearing material input. Comparing an affine density to it is not an ASD utilization, a dowel yield calculation or a complete adjusted joint capacity. No multi-member Rd, Cg or Cdelta is adopted.

The existing NDS component diameter route selects the catalog root-floor scenario after a member fails the quarter-thread exception. This constant bearing-screen diameter does not replace the partially threaded shaft model or transfer a full-thread-root sensitivity into the basis. Delivered shank, runout and root remain unobserved.
The supplier Q235B label supplies no adopted eoere hole-bearing resistance. Steel required bearing stress is reported without a product capacity.

Original source field same-cut shaft markers are reused with their original geometry, thread and material limits. No new nonlinear shaft yield, axial-seat, washer pressure, joint splitting or formed-heel acceptance.
Panel/screw remedies stay paused. No geometry change, member enlargement, new fastener, floor test, physical work, native solve or revised frame response.
Keep prior immutable studies and all peer work. Raw detailed member rows, case stacks and source pins stay in ignored output; no pruning or copied manuals.
